scope: Synthetic NumPy UI mock; no GPU or body run

v_rest.source: Shiu et al. 2024, Nature, doi:10.1038/s41586-024-07763-9; Methods 'Computational model': 'Vresting = -52 mV (resting potential)'; reference code github.com/philshiu/Drosophila_brain_model@91bdd1e7dcf193f3e7ca5a8933497fcef63b7960 model.py:22 'v_0' : -52 * mV # resting potential

v_reset.source: Shiu et al. 2024, Nature, doi:10.1038/s41586-024-07763-9; Methods 'Computational model': 'Vreset = -52 mV (reset potential after spike)'; reference code github.com/philshiu/Drosophila_brain_model@91bdd1e7dcf193f3e7ca5a8933497fcef63b7960 model.py:23 'v_rst' : -52 * mV # reset potential after spike

v_threshold.source: Shiu et al. 2024, Nature, doi:10.1038/s41586-024-07763-9; Methods 'Computational model': 'Vthreshold = -45 mV (threshold for spiking)'; reference code github.com/philshiu/Drosophila_brain_model@91bdd1e7dcf193f3e7ca5a8933497fcef63b7960 model.py:24 'v_th' : -45 * mV # threshold for spiking

tau_m.source: Shiu et al. 2024, Nature, doi:10.1038/s41586-024-07763-9; Methods 'Computational model': 'Tmbr = Cmb x Rmbr' with 'Rmbr = 10 Kohm cm2', 'Cmbr = 2 uF cm-2'; reference code github.com/philshiu/Drosophila_brain_model@91bdd1e7dcf193f3e7ca5a8933497fcef63b7960 model.py:25 't_mbr' : 20 * ms # membrane time scale

tau_syn.source: Shiu et al. 2024, Nature, doi:10.1038/s41586-024-07763-9; Methods 'Computational model': 'tau = 5 ms (synapse decay timescale)'; reference code github.com/philshiu/Drosophila_brain_model@91bdd1e7dcf193f3e7ca5a8933497fcef63b7960 model.py:28 'tau' : 5 * ms # time constant

t_ref.source: Shiu et al. 2024, Nature, doi:10.1038/s41586-024-07763-9; Methods 'Computational model': 'Trefractory = 2.2 ms (refractory period)'; reference code github.com/philshiu/Drosophila_brain_model@91bdd1e7dcf193f3e7ca5a8933497fcef63b7960 model.py:31 't_rfc' : 2.2 * ms # refractory period

delay.source: Shiu et al. 2024, Nature, doi:10.1038/s41586-024-07763-9; Methods 'Computational model': 'Tdly = 1.8 ms (time delay from spike to change in membrane potential)'; reference code github.com/philshiu/Drosophila_brain_model@91bdd1e7dcf193f3e7ca5a8933497fcef63b7960 model.py:34 't_dly' : 1.8*ms # delay for changes in post-synaptic neuron

w_syn.rationale: synthetic graph only: the preset 0.275 mV gives sub-mV PSPs on this graph, so nothing downstream of the stimulus spikes; 1.8 mV was picked by a coarse scan (0.8-2.5 mV) as a value where activity spreads without running away. Demonstration, not calibration

limitations: Uniform LIF parameters for every neuron; not measured for MaleCNS neurons.
w_syn is ASSUMED (copied from a female-brain model's free parameter), not calibrated.
Synapse signs come from an ASSUMED transmitter mapping; see synapse_sign in this manifest.
Current-based synapses, one uniform delay, no gap junctions, neuromodulation or plasticity.
A single run is not a statistical result; replicate seeds before comparing conditions.
